For security vulnerabilities, use [private reporting](https://github.com/talktoajayprakash/stratos/security/advisories/new).

## What happened?

Describe the expected behavior and what happened instead.

## Reproduction

Include the smallest workflow or commands that reproduce the problem.

## Environment

- Stratos version or commit:
- Operating system and Node.js version:
- Harness, model provider, and MCP server, if relevant:

## Diagnostics

Include relevant errors or logs. Remove credentials, tokens, personal data,
and private workflow content before sharing.
